title: SFX — Gleam earned (constellation relit)
_note: Worked SFX example for a BIG diegetic reward: a wide bright rising arpeggio that hints the Vesper motif (G->C->D ... settling up), with a noise 'aurora' up-whoosh underneath and a long bell shimmer. Layering + glide + a held bell. Render with a long ring-out:  render --tail 0.7  -> public/assets/audio/sfx/world-gleam-a.mp3. Allowed to run ~1s (the only class of SFX that may). See references/sfx-cookbook.md §B.
